answer: Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 176 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Because the sonnet reference is updated at each violet checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the umber audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
